headlines.title: CrowdStrike announces 'kill switch' for AI agents that go rogue
headlines.summary: CrowdStrike has agreed to buy two AI security startups for a combined purchase price of $495 million, according to the Wall Street Journal.

headlines.title: Jim Cramer Praises New “AI Kill Switch,” Says “You Should Just Go Buy CrowdStrike”
headlines.summary: Jim Cramer just told viewers to buy a cybersecurity stock after its CEO showed him what he called the holy grail of AI safety, but the product itself carries a significant warning buried in the fine print.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike Unveils Agentic Adversary Emulation on the Falcon Platform to Identify and Close Exploitable Attack Paths
headlines.summary: AUSTIN, Texas & BARCELONA, Spain, November 04, 2026--Fal.Con Europe 2026 -- CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) today unveiled Agentic Adversary Emulation, powered by SafeMind, the company’s family of purpose-built security models and harnesses. The new offering red teams a customer’s environment like an agentic adversary, chaining vulnerabilities and weaknesses into exploitable paths to an organization's critical assets.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike Extends the Agentic SOC to Detect and Stop the Agent Insider Threat
headlines.summary: AUSTIN, Texas & BARCELONA, Spain, November 04, 2026--Fal.Con Europe 2026 -- CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) today introduced agentic SOC innovations to detect the new insider threat: enterprise AI agents that act faster than any human can respond. Agent Insider Threat Detection exposes abnormal agent behavior and routes deviations into coordinated, multi-agent investigations that run across every domain at the same time.

headlines.title: “The Ban Hammer Is Coming Down” on AI Coding Agents. CrowdStrike Is Selling the Kill Switch
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysGoldman Sachs has barred most of its bankers and traders from AI coding tools like Claude Code, and Replit CEO Amjad Masad says bans like it are widespread in finance. CrowdStrike launched an AI Kill Switch for rogue agents and agreed to buy two AI security startups for a reported $495 million combined.

description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. provides cybersecurity solutions in the United States and internationally. Its unified platform provides cloud-delivered protection of endpoints, cloud workloads, identity, and data through a software as a service (SaaS) subscription-based model. The company offers corporate endpoint and cloud workload security, managed security, security and vulnerability management, IT operations management, identity protection, threat intelligence, data protection, SaaS security posture management, and AI powered workflow automation, and securing generative AI workload services, as well as security orchestration, automation, and response; and security information and event management, and log management services. It primarily sells subscriptions to its Falcon platform and cloud modules. The company has a strategic alliance with Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation to help enterprises secure artificial intelligence across its lifecycle, from the AI agents and models to the foundational infrastructure that supports the entire AI ecosystem and with Snowflake to bring AI-native security and enterprise data at scale. Additionally, it has a partnership with Fortanix Inc. to combine its Falcon platform with Fortanix Confidential AI to provide an integrated solution for end-to-end AI security. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
